description:
Hi!

I'm a Space Science BSc graduate. I'm interested in space weather and the connection between the Earth and Sun and our way of understanding it. I'm also a fan of writing and creating art, therefore I'm planning to create a storytelling video. I'm looking for one team member with a similar interest, who has an understanding of hardware and space concepts. I prefer a calm low stress workflow.
summary: My project is a storytelling about STEREO-B, an observatory from the STEREO mission. I have created a video telling the story of STEREO-B in a fun way using a conversation between two seagulls. It is a great importance to provide a fun way of teaching space history and exploration that can be used for kids or anyone who likes a fun way of learning.
details: My project: STEREO-B, A drop in the past of solar exploration, is a video telling the story of STEREO-B, it introduces a fun way of learning about space missions and how we explored and learned about the Sun. I have used a picture that I took of aurora along with an illustration of STEREO-B available online, and a picture of the Sun taken by STEREO, and added illustrations over them using Adobe Fresco. I have then used Microsoft PowerPoint and Teams to record the video. My project is creative in the way it combines real pictures with illustration and scientific facts with a fun story of seagulls watching the aurora.
